entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-11
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • IDE0065 fix (`csharp_using_directive_placement = outside_namespace`) changes what names bind to, and `dotnet format` applies it silently: CS0104, CS0118 #86002
  • `dotnet format` crashes with "Changes must be within bounds of SourceText" in `LinkedFileMergeConflictCommentAdditionService` (multi-targeted project, CRLF file, `end_of_line = lf`) #86001
  • Fix All in a multi-targeted project writes merge conflict markers into source when code exists in only some target frameworks (IDE0040, IDE0011, IDE0047, IDE0048, IDE0055) #86000

Closed

  • Razor Tag Helpers with ParentTag appear to not execute at all despite supposedly matching. #85971

PullRequests

Created

  • docs(banned-api): add package readme and bundle with NuGet package #85999
    Community
  • fix(analyzers): restrict NamedTypeFullNameNotNullSuppressor to C# #85998
    Community

Merged

  • Fix ParentTag binding for Tag Helpers inside plain HTML elements #85981
    Community, Area-Razor
